facilities.name: Samuel Adams Pennsylvania Brewery - Breinigsville PA
facilities.type: Brewery / production facility (largest in network; includes ~1M sq ft brewery + warehouse space on ~76 acres)
facilities.source: Dossier (PA brewery, Savastano's home site); Yelp, Lehigh Valley Chamber, Trade & Industry Development, D&B all confirm 7880 Penn Dr, Breinigsville PA 18031 (Fogelsville/Lehigh Valley)

facilities.name: Cincinnati Brewery - Cincinnati OH
facilities.type: Brewery / canning production facility (Over-the-Rhine; $85M canning expansion 2020 quadrupled canning capacity)
facilities.source: Dossier (Cincinnati Brewery, $85M canning build); REDI Cincinnati, Food Processing, CityBeat confirm 1625 Central Parkway, Over-the-Rhine (former Hudepohl-Schoenling/Schoenling plant)

facilities.name: Milton Brewery (Dogfish Head) - Milton DE
facilities.type: Brewery / production facility (Dogfish Head main production; acquired by Boston Beer 2019)
facilities.source: Dossier (Milton DE brewery); Dogfish Head official site, Yelp, Brewbound confirm 6 Cannery Village Center, Milton DE 19968

facilities.name: Samuel Adams Boston Brewery - Jamaica Plain, Boston MA
facilities.type: Brewery / production facility (heritage Jamaica Plain site; smaller footprint, taproom-attached)
facilities.source: Dossier (Jamaica Plain heritage brewery); Yelp, Apple Maps, BeerAdvocate confirm 30 Germania St, Boston MA 02130 (Jamaica Plain)

facilities.name: Angry Orchard Innovation Cidery - Walden NY
facilities.type: Cidery / production facility (company-owned 60-acre apple orchard + Innovation Cider House; specialty/small-batch cider production)
facilities.source: Boston Beer 10-K (Item 2: company owns apple orchard and cidery in Walden NY); Yelp, I Love NY confirm 2241 Albany Post Rd, Walden NY 12586. Note: majority of Angry Orchard volume is produced at the Cincinnati Brewery; Walden is R&D/specialty cider
